name: seovision
description: SeoVision in ChatGPT and Codex: your site's audits, AI-search visibility, articles and backlinks from your SeoVision account.

interface.longDescription:
SeoVision gets a website ranking in Google and cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, and does the work for its customers: site audits, AI-visibility tracking per market and model, articles written and published to the customer's site, and backlinks from real sites.

This plugin connects your SeoVision account to the conversation. Ask what to fix first on your site, how often AI assistants name your brand and which competitors they name instead, which articles go out this week, what Search Console shows, or for a weekly report to share with your team. You can also approve the content plan, publish or edit articles, manage tracked prompts and competitors, and connect your site.

Who it is for: owners and marketers of websites, online stores and agencies that use SeoVision.

Limits: it works with an existing SeoVision account and shows only the projects you can access, with the same roles as the SeoVision dashboard. Plans and payments are managed in the SeoVision dashboard. Anything that publishes to your live site, deletes, or sends something outside SeoVision shows a preview first and runs only after you confirm in the chat.
defaultPrompt: What should I fix first on my site?
How visible is my brand in AI answers this month?

review.commerce_description: SeoVision does not sell anything inside ChatGPT or Codex. People sign in to an existing SeoVision account, and plans and payments stay in the SeoVision dashboard.

publication.release_notes: First release: audits, AI-search visibility, articles, Search Console, backlinks and site connections from your SeoVision account, with three workflows: get started, SEO health check and weekly report.
